items.title: Create Research M0 execution artifacts and status table
items.context: Add M0-only artifacts under experiments/multi-model-ablation that record the story scope, milestone table, provider-call boundary, and formal pass/blocker states.

happy.desc: M0 status records all requested milestones and says Phase 1/2 cells were not run.

edge.desc: Existing example artifacts remain example-only and are not overwritten as real outcomes.

adversarial.desc: A host-only audit cannot be mistaken for a formal ablation record.

items.userSees: User opens experiments/multi-model-ablation/m0-status.md and sees the Research M0 milestone table plus providerCallsMade=false and phase1OrPhase2CellsRun=false.

verificationEvidence.note: M0 status records M0.1-M0.7 and explicitly states providerCallsMade=false, containsOutcomeData=false, phase1OrPhase2CellsRun=false, and productGateImpact=none.
The checker validates dedicated .m0 artifacts while existing .example artifacts remain example-only and pass their original provider-free invariant checks.
Research boundary fields and eligibleForOutcomeRecords=false prevent host-only audit output from being mistaken for formal ablation records.

items.title: Implement provider-safe M0 smoke checker
items.context: Add a local Node checker that validates runner registration, host/model separation, tool-surface digest binding, prompt digest binding, A2prime budget lock ordering, and legal/illegal contrast rules.

happy.desc: The checker passes on the M0 artifacts and prints assertion counts.

edge.desc: The checker rejects missing budgetLockDigest or missing reviewerSnapshot where required.

adversarial.desc: The checker rejects illegal ② vs ④ as a confirmatory contrast.

items.userSees: User runs node experiments/multi-model-ablation/m0-smoke-check.mjs and sees M0 smoke check passed with assertion counts.

verificationEvidence.note: The provider-safe checker passes on committed M0 artifacts and prints passed provider-safe local checks plus negative-control confirmation.
Negative controls in the checker mutate in-memory fixtures and reject missing A2prime budgetLockDigest plus missing same/cross reviewerSnapshot.
Negative control marks ②-vs-④ as legalConfirmatory=true and the checker rejects it because executor and reviewer both change.

items.title: Record runner and snapshot readiness evidence
items.context: Capture CLI host availability and selected E1/E2 provider family snapshot candidates without conflating Codex/Claude hosts with model families.

happy.desc: E1 and E2 families are distinct and each runner separates hostKind from executorSnapshot/reviewerSnapshot.

edge.desc: If dated snapshot binding is unavailable, the artifact records a blocker instead of silently passing.

adversarial.desc: Using Codex CLI as host without an OpenAI/GPT snapshot cannot satisfy E2.

items.userSees: User opens runner-registry.m0.json and model-snapshot-lock.m0.json and sees hostKind recorded separately from executorSnapshot/reviewerSnapshot for E1 and E2.

items.title: Verify budget-lock and analysis contrast mechanics
items.context: Create or validate M0 cells and budget lock fixtures that prove ③ precedes ⑥ and that only ③ vs ⑥, ① vs ②, and ③ vs ④ are legal confirmatory contrasts.
relatedDocs: docs/requirements/decisions/multi-model-ablation-replication.md#311-2x2-因果对比矩阵每次只允许一个因子变

happy.desc: A2prime rows bind to a previously frozen budget lock and legal contrasts are enumerated.

edge.desc: Descriptive-only contrasts are kept separate from confirmatory contrasts.

adversarial.desc: ② vs ④ is detected as invalid because executor and reviewer both change.

items.userSees: User opens cell-manifest.m0.json and phase1-budget-lock.m0.json and sees A2prime rows bound to frozen budget locks plus legal and forbidden contrast declarations.

items.title: Run verification and close the Research M0 story
items.context: Run the M0 smoke checker, provider-free example checks, relevant Lattice validation, then record summary/delivery evidence and advance to DONE if gates pass.

happy.desc: Verification evidence proves M0 readiness or explicit blockers and no Phase 1/2 campaign was run.

edge.desc: Validation remains provider-safe and does not mutate product gates/playbooks/runtime guidance.

adversarial.desc: DONE summary cannot overclaim that H-M1/H-M3 research outcomes exist.

items.userSees: User sees final verification evidence showing M0 readiness/pass-or-blocker status, no Phase 1/2 cells run, and no product gate/playbook/runtime impact.

auditLog.reason: M0 status and boundary artifacts implemented and smoke-verified.
